decision: Keep the fixed 110mAh battery and requirements. The arithmetic target is <=4.4mA, but the current design has neither a conservative completed-device upper bound nor a physical 16h result. An unnecessary continuous HSI16 clock was removed; feasibility remains unconfirmed until measurement.

battery.usable_capacity_definition: Capacity delivered after the final 4.1V nominal on-board charging profile (4.1205V guaranteed maximum) until the final loaded recording stop threshold, including connector/protection/LDO loss, at the qualified temperature and ageing endpoints.

adopted_design_allocation.peak_note: 110mA is treated as a never-exceed complete-pack limit; no unsupported pulse allowance. Regulator droop and storage inrush impose additional prototype checks.

record_encrypt_store_path.codec: IMA ADPCM in WAV, then binary age v1 X25519 encryption
record_encrypt_store_path.capacity_conclusion: Selected 8Gbit MKDV8GIL-AST is 1GB nominal. FAT32 data-area budget is 929787904 bytes; energy, startup/inrush, availability, formatted capacity and filesystem behavior remain qualification gates.

current_allocation_mA.accounting_warning: The 2.8mA base is an allocation hypothesis, not a component sum or measurement. Encryption is included only by intended bucket scope, not by evidence. Do not add these nested estimates to a measured whole-battery integral.

stage1_gate.why: The 2.8mA non-storage value is only an allocation and the selected LDO MCU's datasheet maximum can itself exceed the whole-device target at elevated temperature. No completed-device upper bound or physical integral exists.
must_be_true_before_release: Measured battery-side charge over each complete 16h recording run is <=70.4mAh and the device remains recording through16h.
At least the qualified worst-case on-board-charge/temperature/age condition delivers >=70.4mAh to the recording stop threshold, or measured average is reduced so runtime still passes.
Whole-device instantaneous battery current never exceeds110mA and no storage startup/write event causes reset, corruption or audio overrun.
Every 10s segment is encrypted and durably committed; decrypted continuous audio, timestamps/sequence and missing-segment checks cover the full run.
A filled/aged selected storage unit preserves at least30h without overwrite and passes recovery after injected power loss.
measurement_buckets: Battery-side full-session integral: authoritative runtime evidence.
3.3V storage-rail integral and peak waveform: diagnoses storage allocation/inrush.
3.3V nonstorage integral while capture+IMA+age run: replaces the unmeasured2.8mA allocation.
Usable pack capacity after on-board charge to loaded stop: validates the capacity envelope.

not_claimed: The 70% usable-capacity fraction is not a battery guarantee.
CSNP32GCR01-BOW is not adopted solely by this energy screen.
Ordinary recording uses the release configuration with automatic indication disabled; terminal/fault indication is a separate non-recording state and still requires energy/safety EVT.
No PCB, case, procurement or charging-temperature release follows from this document.

limits: Measured medium sector count still required; example capacity is synthetic.
Generated empty image excludes product identity and recipient provisioning.
Full medium image programming and physical readback not performed.
Three-session endpoint rounding remains allocation budget, not this single-stream test.
